title: NTI-1 justification_receipt (exemption)
description: A signed record of an accepted exemption under Voluntary Oblivious Compliance. The protocol verifies the signature and records the receipt; it does not evaluate the justification. Two boundaries are structural rather than advisory: halt.cause admits only policy_violation, and exemption_covers is fixed, so a receipt that purports to exempt a revocation or an undetermined authority cannot be expressed at all.

receipt_version.description: Schema version. A change to the boundary rules is a version change, not a field change.

receipt_id.description: Unique identifier for this receipt. MUST NOT be reused.

request_id.description: The halted action this receipt applies to. Binds the receipt to one call so it cannot be replayed onto another.

policy_id.description: The policy that denied the action.

cause.description: The only halt an exemption may answer. authority_revoked and authority_not_determined are deliberately absent from this enumeration, so an exempted revocation is not expressible.

reason.description: Why policy denied the action. Recorded, not evaluated.

resume_basis.description: Fixed. An evidence based resume is a different object and MUST NOT be represented by this schema.

reason.description: The accountability layer's stated reason. Free text by design: the protocol does not read it. Anything that needs to be counted belongs in a closed field, not here.

evidence_refs.description: Optional references the grader relied on. Recorded for the auditor, not checked by the protocol.

grader_id.description: The automated agent grader that accepted the risk and signed.

grader_role.description: The role under which it acted. An auditor needs this to tell a compliance officer from a release manager.

mandate_id.description: The mandate under which the grader was authorised to accept risk. A signature proves which grader signed; the mandate is what shows it was ever entitled to. A receipt without one is a statement about a key, not about authority.

mandate_ref.description: The signed mandate itself, embedded so an auditor can verify the authority chain without a second lookup. Its issuer must not be the grader: self authorisation is not authority.

principal_id.description: The legal party the agent acts for.

delegation_id.description: The delegation under which the halted action was taken, so a reader can check its state at resume time.

not_after.description: When the exemption stops being usable. An exemption without an end is a permanent waiver, so this is required even when empty elsewhere.

chain_event_hash.description: The audit event this receipt is attached to, binding the exemption into the tamper evident chain.

alg.description: Signature algorithm. The specification mandates a post-quantum scheme (CRYSTALS-Dilithium5); the harness uses HMAC-SHA256 to test protocol shape only.

value.description: Signature over the RFC 8785 canonical form of the receipt with the signature object removed.
